source.rationale: dym-transform / dym-annotate pass the not-found payload through and APPEND their own control keys; this node must delete all fourteen so its output stays byte-identical to the pre-dym-probe shape on every un-annotated path. Each key is seeded with a sentinel here, so dropping any one of them from _DYM_CTRL_KEYS leaks a visible value. (Reviewer F-STRIP: dym_capped_codes / probe_cap_applied were the two that got missed the first time.)
